notes: DumbBudget is a single Express server (server.js) serving the static front end from public/ and storing everything in data/transactions.json. Node 20.19.5 pinned in mise.toml (the repo's Dockerfile uses node:20), deps from npm ci. start.sh runs `node server.js` with PORT, BASE_URL=http://localhost:$PORT, CURRENCY=USD, and DUMBBUDGET_PIN=2468. The app is PIN-protected, so / redirects to /login: type the 4-digit PIN 2468 (it auto-submits) to reach the main dashboard. Data: .ui-capture/seed.mjs (run through .ui-capture/reseed.sh) logs in and POSTs 595 transactions through the app's own /api/transactions endpoint. They cover Aug 2025 to 17 Nov 2026 for a Portland graphic designer: semi-monthly paychecks, freelance invoices, tax refunds, and Venmo repayments as income; groceries, dining, transport, shopping, health, pets, utilities, gifts, and travel (a Thanksgiving flight, a Mexico City trip) as expenses. 13 recurring rules (rent, which changes amount at the August lease renewal; streaming and other subscriptions; a gym membership cancelled in March; 6-month car insurance; HYSA transfers; a student loan) are expanded by the server into per-month instances. Many entries have notes. A snapshot is kept in .ui-capture/seed-data/transactions.json, and start.sh restores it if data/ is empty. The main UI is one page: a date-range picker (defaults to the current month, Nov 2026), income/expense/balance totals, a transaction list with All/Income/Expense filters and sorting by date or amount, an add/edit modal (type, category, amount, description, notes, date, recurring options), CSV and PDF export, and a light/dark theme toggle. Widen the date range (e.g. 2025-08-01 to 2026-11-30) to see all of the history. Known app quirk: the server HTML-escapes input and the client escapes it again, so & ' / would show as entities. The seed avoids those characters.
